events.name: Race weekend
events.summary: Up to 125,000 spectators a day across the grandstands, general admission banks and gates.

events.name: Conference day
events.summary: The pit building, halls and amphitheatre host conventions and exhibitions all year.

locations.name: Blue Mountain Racing Circuit
locations.description: An illustrative 4.8 km circuit with a long braking approach, a flowing middle section and a compact operational infield. The main racing compound and limited VIP hospitality remain inside; academy and automotive campuses sit outside. Not a published BMR masterplan.

locations.name: Pit Lane
locations.description: An infield pit entry peels off before the final western bend, then runs past the apron and garage doors. The exit blends back onto the straight with a matching direction of travel.

locations.name: Pit / Conference Building
locations.description: West-facing garages open onto the infield pit apron. Conference floors have a separate public entrance at the south end, reached by the pedestrian bridge.

locations.name: Paddock
locations.description: Team compound directly behind the garages. Two rows of support units and equipment awnings flank loading courts, transverse lanes and a rear service spine.

locations.name: Grandstand A
locations.description: Covered grandstand at the southern end of the start-finish straight, looking across to the pit building. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand B
locations.description: Covered grandstand on the start-finish straight, opposite the pit garages and the start line. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand C
locations.description: Covered grandstand overlooking the heavy braking zone into Turn 1. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand D
locations.description: Covered grandstand outside the hairpin at the end of the long straight. Illustrative.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 1
locations.description: Grass bank inside Turn 1 and Turn 2.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 2
locations.description: Viewing bank outside the flowing middle section, behind its protective boundary.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 3
locations.description: Grass viewing bank beside the diagonal return towards the southern corners.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 4
locations.description: Grass bank looking north over Turns 10 and 11.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 5
locations.description: Grass bank inside Turns 12 and 13.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 6
locations.description: Grass bank on the outside of the final corner, looking up the start-finish straight.

locations.name: Arrival Plaza
locations.description: The public front door of the venue, between the gateway arch, the halls and the pit / conference building.

locations.name: Grandstand Fan Walk
locations.description: Tree-lined processional avenue from the gateway arch, through the arrival plaza, to a concourse behind Grandstands A and B. Banners line it all year, with food and merchandise stalls on race weekends.

locations.name: Gateway Arch
locations.description: The landmark arch at the western edge of the arrival plaza.

locations.name: Plaza Tower North
locations.description: Stone-clad tower marking the northern side of the arrival plaza.

locations.name: Plaza Tower South
locations.description: Stone-clad tower marking the southern side of the arrival plaza.

locations.name: Exhibition Hall 1
locations.description: Smaller exhibition hall beside the arrival plaza, for conventions and meetings. The largest shows use the lakeside Expo Centre.

locations.name: Exhibition Hall 2
locations.description: Smaller exhibition hall beside the arrival plaza, for conventions and meetings. The largest shows use the lakeside Expo Centre.

locations.name: Expo Centre
locations.description: The venue's largest exhibition space: four connected halls on a glazed central concourse, about 5 hectares, facing the lake. Trucks load from Waterfront Drive on its western side.

locations.name: Expo forecourt
locations.description: Lake-facing public arrival court for the Expo Centre, connected to the lakeside promenade.

locations.name: Expo loading yard
locations.description: Truck docks along the western side of the Expo Centre, served directly from Waterfront Drive and kept apart from visitors.

locations.name: Expo Walk
locations.description: Public walk from the arrival concourse and Car Park P8 to the Expo Centre forecourt, with a branch to the lakeside promenade.

locations.name: Amphitheatre
locations.description: Stepped open-air bowl for concerts and events, facing the arrival plaza.

locations.name: The Lake
locations.description: The centrepiece of the waterfront precinct, with the promenade around its edge.

locations.name: Lakeside Promenade
locations.description: A walking loop around the lake, linking the restaurants and hotels.

locations.name: Lakeside Restaurant West
locations.description: Timber pavilion with a dark metal roof, opening onto the promenade.

locations.name: Lakeside Restaurant Central
locations.description: Timber pavilion with a dark metal roof, opening onto the promenade.

locations.name: Lakeside Restaurant East
locations.description: Timber pavilion with a dark metal roof, opening onto the promenade.

locations.name: Waterfront Hotel
locations.description: Tower hotel on the south shore, with views over the lake to the circuit.

locations.name: Lakeside Lodge
locations.description: Low-rise hotel on the south shore.

locations.name: Promenade Hotel
locations.description: Mid-rise hotel at the western end of the waterfront.

locations.name: Karting Track
locations.description: Karting circuit in the separate south-west academy campus, outside the main racing circuit.

locations.name: Karting Clubhouse
locations.description: Karting preparation, timing and a viewing deck in the south-west academy campus.

locations.name: Karting Garages
locations.description: Two rows of small lock-up garages beside the clubhouse, opening onto the karting pit apron, with rear access from the campus road.

locations.name: Karting pit apron
locations.description: Paved working apron between the karting garages and the track.

locations.name: Driving Academy
locations.description: Academy classrooms and simulators beside the karting track in the south-west campus.

locations.name: Academy Skid Pad
locations.description: Open square of low-grip surface where drivers learn to control skids and slides, with painted circles and cones. Part of the driving academy and advanced driving courses.

locations.name: Skid pad markings
locations.description: Painted boundary and two control circles on the skid pad.

locations.name: Skid pad control cabin
locations.description: Instructor cabin overlooking the skid pad.

locations.name: Automotive Hub
locations.description: Engineering workshops in a separate eastern automotive campus, connected to the test pad and demonstration compound.

locations.name: Automotive Test Pad
locations.description: Vehicle test apron beside the external Automotive Hub.

locations.name: Infield drainage and grass reserve
locations.description: Low grass, drainage ground and a planted buffer behind the team compound. Reserved for separation and venue operations, with no public activity in the circuit protective areas.

locations.name: Trackside Residences East
locations.description: Apartments and townhouses looking west across the circuit. Illustrative.

locations.name: Trackside Residences South
locations.description: Apartments and townhouses looking north over the infield section of the circuit. Illustrative.

locations.name: Retail Quarter
locations.description: Shops and offices east of the ring road, further out from the circuit. Illustrative.

locations.name: Research and Technology Park
locations.description: Research and technology blocks at the south-eastern edge of the site. Illustrative.

locations.name: N7 National Road
locations.description: The highway along the site's western edge, with direct frontage and two interchanges.

locations.name: N7 North Interchange
locations.description: Links the N7 to the ring road, with slip roads in both directions.

locations.name: N7 South Interchange
locations.description: Links the N7 to the ring road, with slip roads in both directions.

locations.name: Ring Road
locations.description: Circulation road around the circuit, serving the car parks and gates.

locations.name: Waterfront Drive
locations.description: Loop road serving the hotels, the south side of the lake and the Expo Centre loading yard.

locations.name: Infield Road
locations.description: Operations bridge over the southern circuit section. A restricted service spine reaches the paddock, team logistics yard and hospitality delivery edge. Academy and automotive traffic use separate external campus roads.

locations.name: Car Park P1
locations.description: Between the N7 and the ring road, by the north interchange.

locations.name: Car Park P2

locations.name: Car Park P3

locations.name: Shuttle Drop-off
locations.description: Shuttle buses from the station, car parks and aerodrome set down here.

locations.name: Kalbaskraal Station
locations.description: The nearest railway station, within walking distance along the fan walk.

locations.name: Railway Line
locations.description: The line through Kalbaskraal station.

locations.name: Station Fan Walk
locations.description: Walking route from Kalbaskraal station around the outside of the automotive campus to the eastern ring-road entrance.

locations.name: Aerodrome Road

locations.name: Aerodrome Runway

locations.name: Pit working apron
locations.description: Working bays between the pit lane and garage doors, east of the pit wall.

locations.name: Paddock service aisles
locations.description: Continuous loading aisles and cross lanes connect the rear garage doors and team rows to the service spine.

locations.name: Team support rows
locations.description: Permanent team support units, covered equipment bays and open loading courts. Race weekend adds transporters in the covered bays.

locations.name: Conference pedestrian bridge
locations.description: Public bridge from the arrival concourse over the start-finish straight and pit lane. Ramped approaches connect to the south conference entrance and the hospitality walk without using paddock service aisles.

locations.name: Conference entrance walk
locations.description: Public concourse from the arrival plaza to the bridge, behind the main stands.

locations.name: Infield guest walk
locations.description: Guest route from the footbridge to the south conference entrance and hospitality courtyard. It remains south of the team compound and west of vehicle access.

locations.name: Conference entrance
locations.description: Public south lobby of the pit building, separate from team loading behind the garages.

locations.name: Infield hospitality courtyard
locations.description: Guest compound overlooking the southern return, with pavilions, shaded court and viewing terrace. Deliveries arrive at its north edge; guests approach from the west.

locations.name: Infield hospitality pavilions
locations.description: Three permanent pavilions opening onto the shaded courtyard and southern viewing terrace.

locations.name: Infield viewing terrace
locations.description: Open terrace looking south towards the return corners, behind the protective boundary.

locations.name: Hospitality courtyard paths
locations.description: Pedestrian courtyard, pavilion entrances and viewing terrace connected to the public guest walk.

locations.name: Hospitality shade court
locations.description: Raised shade canopy around the guest courtyard.

locations.name: Infield drainage swale
locations.description: Drainage strip through the reserved infield grass, clear of the paddock and track protection.

locations.name: Academy handling ground
locations.description: Vehicle-control and slalom compound in the south-west academy campus, connected to karting and the skid pan.

locations.name: Academy handling course
locations.description: A low-speed handling loop with a separate slalom lane, briefing bays and access from the south campus road.

locations.name: Academy briefing bays
locations.description: Covered preparation and briefing bays connected to the external handling course.

locations.name: Automotive demonstration court
locations.description: Vehicle demonstration compound in the eastern automotive campus, outside the racing circuit.

locations.name: Automotive demonstration loop
locations.description: A marked low-speed loop around vehicle display courts and preparation bays.

locations.name: Vehicle display courts
locations.description: Permanent light-paved demonstration bays inside the automotive loop, with clear circulation around them.

locations.name: Automotive preparation bays
locations.description: Preparation pavilions grouped along the demonstration compound service edge.

locations.name: Demonstration bay markings
locations.description: Marked display bays inside the automotive demonstration loop.

locations.name: Academy campus access
locations.description: External access from the western ring road to karting, its garages, classrooms, skid pad and handling ground.

locations.name: Automotive campus access
locations.description: External access from the eastern ring road to engineering, testing and demonstration facilities.

locations.name: Team logistics yard
locations.description: Restricted team truck holding, equipment preparation and service circulation north of the garages. This is part of the racing compound, separate from guest access.

locations.name: Team logistics service aisle
locations.description: A clear turning and loading aisle through the northern team support yard.

locations.name: Team equipment tents
locations.description: Two grouped equipment shelters facing the logistics aisle, with room for truck holding around them.

locations.name: Circuit response access
locations.description: External response route behind the eastern spectator banks and protective boundaries. Connects the ring road to the middle and southern sectors.
